name: Animated Gradient Button
description: Accessible call-to-action button with a smooth animated multi-stop gradient border and glow, reduced-motion support, and zero JavaScript dependencies.

preview.caption: Interactive live preview — hover, focus with Tab, or customize the CSS variables below.

install: Copy button.html and button.css into your web project, or paste the CSS custom properties into your design system stylesheet.
usage: Add class="otter-grad-btn" to any <button> or <a> element. Override --btn-c1, --btn-c2, --btn-radius, or --btn-speed on the element or :root.

verification.label: Source Reviewed & Live Sandboxed
verification.details: Rendered in an isolated iframe sandbox with prefers-reduced-motion media query and visible keyboard focus outline.
